assertions: Root login redirects to the global /servers index with two normal server anchors and no global status pill.
Selecting a server enters a route-derived shell showing its full name and breadcrumb.
A failed server request produces a server-scoped page alert without creating a global Error pill.
Normal anchors, back, forward, and refresh preserve the server and section URL.
The server switcher changes the route target while preserving the active section.
A global page has null server context and emits no server_id query target.
An invalid server ID returns HTTP 404 with a clear recovery path and available servers.
Global and server-scoped iPhone portrait views have no horizontal page overflow.
